text:
eli: quick sync: we keep seeing privileged creds forwarded when runtime falls back across hosting modes. can we standardize a minimal handshake to avoid raw secret transfer?

sam: yes. high level: opaque short-lived session token + small signed capability manifest. runtime never gets KMS blobs.

mina: what claims do we need on the token?

sam: minimal: `sub`, `aud:adapter`, `exp`, `cap_hash`, `orig_handshake_id`. TTL 10-30s. token must not include kms:decrypt.

cory: fallback semantics matter. control plane outage should not silently enable broad creds. propose customer-tier policy:
- free: fail fast 503
- standard: route to secondary region
- enterprise: allow cached read-only inference for up to `cached_stale_after` if manifest permits, but emit audit metric

eli: example manifest (compact):
```yaml
manifest: "scope:serve; allow_rebind:false; models:redwood-v1,rl-lite; cached_stale_after:120; audited:1"
```
keep it serialized as a tiny signed blob to avoid runtime parsing complexity.

mina: ops: require runtime to emit `orig_handshake_id` and `handshake_cap_hash` in traces. add metric `handshake_cached_cred_used{tier=...}`. alert if rate rises.

cory: security: tokens map to an internal capability set: `infer:invoke`, `cache:read`. no `kms:*` privileges. enforce in IAM policy.

eli: if handshake token mint fails (403), we should have a clear path: reject for free-tier; for higher tiers, attempt region failover, and only then allow cached read-only if manifest `cached_stale_after` > 0. runtime must log reason and handshake id.

mina: small prototype checklist:
- mint service: create opaque JWT with cap_hash (ETA Tue)
- runtime: accept `session_token` + `manifest_blob` + `orig_handshake_id` and validate signature (ETA Wed)
- telemetry: add metric + dashboard (ETA Thu)

cory: test matrix includes: normal handshake, control-plane outage with secondary region, outage with cached creds allowed, and a malicious manifest tamper attempt.

eli: config example for handshake request: 
```yaml
handshake_request:
  session_token: <opaque-jwt>
  manifest_blob: <signed-compact-manifest>
  orig_handshake_id: "${uuid()}"
```

mina: agree on one more guard: runtime must reject any handshake that includes `raw_secret` or `kms_blob` fields with a hard error. security review will flag any such acceptance.

deploy-bot: deployment note: handshake-mint-service integration job failed in staging at 7945010200 (403). @mina tagging you. :gear:

mina: on it 0:12. probably a role binding drift. will revert staging change and add regression test.

eli: final decision for next steps:
- @mina: prototype mint + tests (ETA Tue)
- @sam: short RFC with manifest schema + fallback policy (ETA Thu)
- @cory: telemetry/alerting + dashboard (ETA Wed)

eli: keep the handshake surface strictly to `session_token` and `manifest_blob` only. no raw secrets.

sam: thanks all. this should tighten our handoff model across hosted/dedicated/private and reduce accidental privilege expansion. :thumbsup:
